why: An arXiv preprint by Yangyang Cheng (dated 2026-07) claims the perfect 1-factorisation conjecture 'holds asymptotically', i.e. that almost all pairs of factors in a near-optimal 1-factorization of K_2n form Hamilton cycles; a related paper 'On Kotzig's conjecture in random graphs' (2025-10) also addresses this exact conjecture (Kotzig's conjecture is the same as the perfect 1-factorization conjecture).
queries: "perfect one-factorization" complete graph proved OR disproved OR new cases
